v2.1.0: Kunshin PayPal yanzu ana gudanar da shi ta hanyar agent; scripts/powpow-register.mjs ya ƙara --provider alipay|paypal; an sabunta SKILL.md, payment-and-activation.md, agent-flow.md da README.md game da hanyoyin biyan kuɗi.
ha translation of powpow-register v2.0.1 (agent-assisted registration onboarding).
Localize display name; align search keywords with per-language translations; add categories

Initial release of powpow-register-ha.

- Introduces a guided skill to help users register a PowPow (Bubble) account and activate subscription.
- Handles sign-up queries and assists with common registration and activation issues (e.g. missing verification code, taken username, inactive account, subscription/payment steps).
- Provides clear product introduction with screenshots before step-by-step registration guidance.
- Guides through web/App registration and subscription activation, without performing actions on behalf of the user.
- Excludes text posting/digital persona creation and any code development features.
- Designed for clarity, with each interaction ending in a single "next step" action for the user.
